notes.title: The 30% Discount
notes.notes:
The discount I promised is here.

I just want to remind you that after the discount, the price of the game will increase, not by much but it will(I mean it will be more $5)

Don't miss this chance!

[b][u]What About The Next Update[/u][/b]:

From now on every update will prepare the game for it's biggest major update.

This year will be full of updates for Into The Unknown.

[b][u]When Will The Update Release[/u][/b]:

The next update will most likely be done in 3 days(NOT 100%)

[b][u]How Many Updates Are Still To Come[/u][/b]:

Probably around 10-20(I don't know, it depends on my progress for each update)

[b][u]What To Expect From The Pricing[/u][/b]:

The first thing I want to say is that the maximum price that the game will have, will be $15(It will not go any further)

The idea that I have is that every time the price will increase it will be by $2(It seems decent)

[b][u]Will There Be More Discounts[/u][/b]:

The shortest answer is yes.

notes.title: Phase 3(Done&Release)
notes.notes:
The final Phase of this update is done and Released.

This Phase adds the following:

-improved light
-added torches in the maze
-more details in the forest

The game will have a 30% discount tomorrow or Tuesday.

notes.title: Phase 1(Done)
notes.notes:
The first part of the Performance Update is completed.

I will release it tomorrow.

The next updates may take a little longer than this one.

notes.title: Into The Unknown(Performance Update)-Announcement
notes.notes:
Performance was always a big problem for Into The Unknown, and now I will give my best to solve it.

I will divide this update in three phases.

[u][b]Phase 1[/b][/u]:
-Option Menu

[u][b]Phase 2[/b][/u]:
-Rebuilding the spawn(for better performance)

[u][b]Phase 3[/b][/u]:
-Rebuilding the maze(for better performance)

Phase 2 and 3 were added thanks to some recent coments on the steam page.

I apreciate any advise for this game and I will try to bring everything that is needed.

[u][b]How long will it take[/b][/u]:
Unlike the major update, this one is divide in phases and every time a phase is complet it will be publish.

[u][b]Keeping you in contact[/b][/u]:
When I was working for the major update I wasn't so active and this time I want to change that.

I will post every single day my progress and if you are interested you can follow me on my Twitter(X) account [url=https://twitter.com/Universal_3218]here[/url] where you can leave me a comment about an update that you would like to see in the game or directly on steam if you already have the game.

notes.title: Preparing For The First Major Update(DONE!)
notes.notes:
The moment it's here. The first Major Update for "Into The Unknown" is done. Thanks to this update, the game feels better and more interesting. I want to say how happy I am that it is done, so I can focus on the next part. Now I want to show the + and the - that the game is dealing with.
[u][b]THE + FOR THE GAME[/b][/u]:
-Bigger World
-More To Explore
-Better Maze
-Better Forest
-Better Sky
-More buildings
[u][b]THE - FOR THE GAME[/b][/u]:
-Still not many things to do(But potential for many)
-Bad Performance(Spoilers:In the next update for this game I am going to optimize the game as mush as I can)

notes.title: Preparing For The First Major Update(100% Complete)
notes.notes: The major update is finally done! Sadly I still need time to update the steam page and upload the game to steam to test it first but I will try my best to release it as soon as possible. If I had to say now a date I will say Monday but it is not sure it may be sooner or later.

notes.title: Preparing For The First Major Update(90% Complete)
notes.notes: I am sorry that I was missing for a few days, but now I am back and very happy to say that almost the whole major update is completed. What have I done now? I have created a way better maze for the players to explore and remove the key feature because it was annoying. The maze doesn't have many differences compare to the old one in terms of tasks but in a future update I will make sure to do them. For now I am happy to progress and the only left thing to do are the endings.

notes.title: Preparing For The First Major Update(55% Complete)
notes.notes: In order to make the game more fun and to make more content, today I want to show you that Into The Unknown will have villages to explore and this is also possible for me to add a story mode. Now I still have to work for the villagers, the story and what exactly you have to do there.

notes.title: Preparing For The First Major Update(40% Complete)
notes.notes: So far I've made the map more than twice as big as the first one so now you have more room to move around and I have also added more details to the forest so that it looks more realistic. In my opinion it turned great but you can also leave me a comment about your opinion. Still much work to do and you can also follow me on my Twitter(X) account [url=https://twitter.com/Universal_3218]here[/url].

notes.title: Preparing For The First Major Update
notes.notes:
It is time to prepare for the first major update and I am going to share with you the negatives that I am trying to solve for Into The Unknown:
-I want to add more interesting things to do in the spawn location because all you can do there is admire the forest and the mountains and then just enter the portal and that it. So for the major update I will try to fix this.
-I want to make a better version of the maze because I feel that it's pretty boring and not interesting at all. So for this major update I will try to make the maze more spooky, more interesting and more things to do in it.
-I want to make better endings for the game because the ones that are now are very cheap and not fun at all.
-The last thing that I want to add is to make the game more open world.
 [url=https://twitter.com/Universal_3218]You can follow me on my Twitter(X) account and you can also tell me updates that will work for the game [/url]
